summary: MKDWELL Tech Inc., a BVI-incorporated Nasdaq-listed issuer (MKDW/MKDWW), filed a Form 6-K disclosing ordinary-course sales under its September 11, 2026 At the Market Offering Agreement with Maxim Group LLC as sales agent. As of November 2, 2026, the company had sold 1,881,277 new ordinary shares for gross proceeds of roughly $0.39 million net of agent commission but before other expenses, leaving 36,079,719 shares outstanding. No price per share, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory terms were disclosed. This is a routine shelf-style ATM takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any acceleration in share issuance.
